tasks.title: Door floors follow lidar ground, and refuse when live ground disagrees
tasks.notes: Raised 2026-10-29 during the SUSU I-021 rebuild (southampton-build). Cause class: Defect. feature_build._outside_door_floor takes the door floor from the LIVE top-solid block outside the door. Around SUSU the live ground is stale or low: before undo it held old-build residue (smooth_stone at y44), after `element_undo susu_w33830305` it is ~y42 while lidar ground_y is 51-55 (piazza 55). Dry run therefore puts doors 42-A..D at y42-45 instead of piazza level. Lidar is the height truth (memory: lidar-height-truth); live surface is only for transitions. Fix: derive outside ground from lidar ground_y (DTM block Y) for the cell outside the door; keep floor_offset semantics; when live top-solid and lidar differ by more than a few blocks, refuse that entrance with a message naming the entrance id, live y and lidar y (no silent fallback). DELIVERABLE: `python3 scripts/feature_build.py --world southampton-build worlds/southampton-build/site/builds/susu_w33830305.json` dry run prints doors 42-A..D at about y51-55 with live ground at y42; unit test with live column y42 vs lidar 51 (door follows lidar or refuses per threshold); existing door tests pass. CURRENT WORLD STATE: SUSU is undone (journal entry 465), nothing rebuilt; pond_w141657072 spec (needs water_body clear_above, merged 1ecab1d) not yet applied. After this lands: re-run SUSU dry run, apply SUSU and the pond under scripts/site_lock.py. Hand-off: side-session-notes designer-handoff-susu-pond.md.
